name: Stephanie Bice
bio: a Representative from Oklahoma; born in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma County, Okla., November 11, 1973; graduated from Putnam City High School, Oklahoma City, Okla., 1991; B.A., Oklahoma State University, Stillwater, Okla., 1995; marketing executive; member of the Oklahoma state senate, 2014-2020; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021–present).
